beaches.name: Keramoti
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the eastern end of Keramoti's long beach. One naturist directory carries a detailed but undated entry placing the nudist area beyond the military zone; a second directory entry published in 2021 agrees. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Loutra Eleftheron
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported along most of this remote beach west of Nea Peramos. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2016, 2020 and 2022 describing 90-100% nude use and an informally marked nudist area in the middle; a Greek camping forum post from around 2013 agrees. No designation by any authority is documented.
